## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change (`composer test`)
- [ ] `composer clean` applied (lint, style, rector)
- [ ] Breaking change for existing installs? Mark the changelog heading `(breaking change)` and say what they have to do
- [ ] User-facing change? Added to `docs/intro/changelog.md` under `## D Month YYYY`
- [ ] New docs page? Added to the `nav` in `mkdocs.yml`
